description: DiligenceOps: submit two to 20 provider quotes for the same job, trip leg or purchase (price, fees, tax, what is included or excluded, cancellation and refund terms, timing, validity). The signed comparison gives exact totals and deltas to the lowest, a like-for-like total that prices in items another quote includes, the term differences that change the real price (separately priced items, exclusions, refundability, deposits at risk, expired quotes), and any quote missing terms the others state. POST /api/quote-compare. Reads only the material in the call: no page fetch, no account access, no merchant contact and no money movement. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/diligence-checks-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/diligence-checks/.

currency.description: Currency for quotes that omit their own.

quotes.description: Two to 20 quotes for the same job, trip leg or purchase.

currency.description: Currency or token code, for example USD, EUR or USDC.

discount.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

excluded.description: What the provider says is not included.

fees.description: Fees on top of the price. Mandatory fees count toward the total; optional add-ons count only toward the like-for-like total.

amount.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

optional.description: true for an add-on the buyer can decline, such as a checked bag or rush delivery.

included.description: What the price includes, as the provider states it.

tax.description: A non-negative amount as a decimal string or number, up to 6 places, for example "49.99".

timing.description: Timing as quoted: delivery time, departure, start date or duration.

valid_until.description: ISO date (2026-11-04) or datetime with a timezone (2026-11-04T17:00:00Z).

subject.description: The job, trip leg or purchase the quotes are for.
